items.source: includes - the collection of includes
items.translation: includes - 包含集合

items.source: excludes - the collection of excludes
items.translation: excludes - 排除集合

items.source: exception - the exception to match against
items.translation: exception - 要匹配的异常

items.source: By default, the two instances match if the candidate type is is assignable from the instance type.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果 `candidate` 类型可赋值给`instance` 类型，则这两个实例匹配。

items.source: See ExceptionTypeFilter(Collection, Collection, boolean) for details.
items.translation: 有关详细信息，请参阅ExceptionTypeFilter(Collection, Collection, boolean)。

items.source: See InstanceFilter for details.
items.translation: 有关详细信息，请参阅InstanceFilter。

items.source:
An exception type will match against a given candidate if it is assignable
to that candidate.
items.translation: 如果异常类型可赋值给给定候选类型，则该异常类型将与该候选类型匹配。

items.source: Determine if the type of the supplied exception matches this filter.
items.translation: 确定提供的exception的类型是否与此过滤器匹配。

items.source: Determine if the type of the supplied exception matches this filter, potentially matching against nested causes.
items.translation: 确定提供的exception的类型是否与此过滤器匹配，可能针对嵌套原因进行匹配。

items.source: match in class InstanceFilter<Class<? extends Throwable>>
items.translation: match 在类 InstanceFilter<Class<? extends Throwable>> 中

items.source: matchIfEmpty - the matching result if the includes and the excludes collections are both null or empty
items.translation: matchIfEmpty - 当包含和排除集合均为 null 或为空时的匹配结果

items.source: true if this filter matches the supplied exception
items.translation: true 如果此过滤器匹配提供的异常

items.source: traverseCauses - whether the matching algorithm should recursively match against nested causes of the exception
items.translation: traverseCauses - 匹配算法是否应递归地针对异常的嵌套原因进行匹配

items.source: true if this filter matches the supplied exception or one of its nested causes
items.translation: true 如果此过滤器匹配提供的异常或其嵌套原因之一。

items.source: candidate - a candidate defined by this filter
items.translation: candidate - 由此过滤器定义的候选项

items.source: true if the instance matches the candidate
items.translation: true 表示该实例与候选项匹配。

items.source: Can be overridden by subclasses.
items.translation: 可被子类重写。

items.source: Create a new ExceptionTypeFilter based on include and exclude collections, with the matchIfEmpty flag set to true.
items.translation: 基于包含和排除集合创建一个新的ExceptionTypeFilter，并将matchIfEmpty标志设置为true。

items.source: Determine if the specified instance matches the specified candidate.
items.translation: 确定指定的instance是否与指定的candidate匹配。

items.source: Create a new ExceptionTypeFilter based on include and exclude collections.
items.translation: 基于包含和排除集合创建一个新的ExceptionTypeFilter。

items.source: instance - the instance to check
items.translation: instance - 要检查的实例

items.source: Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen
